pancake-animals.title: Pancake Animals
pancake-animals.intro: Fluffy pancakes you turn into animals you can eat!
steps: Put the flour, sugar and baking powder in the bowl.
Crack the egg into a cup first, then tip it into the bowl.
Pour in the milk and the oil.
Whisk until the batter is smooth, with no big lumps.
A grown-up pours one big circle and two small ear circles into the hot pan.
When bubbles pop on top, the grown-up flips it over.
Slice the banana and strawberries with a butter knife.
Make a bear face: a banana nose, blueberry eyes and strawberry cheeks!
pancake-animals.tip: Try a bunny with long ears, or a cat with banana whiskers.

rainbow-parfait.title: Rainbow Yogurt Parfait
rainbow-parfait.intro: Colourful layers of yogurt and fruit in a clear glass, just like a rainbow!
steps: Peel the mandarin and the banana. Pull the mandarin into pieces.
Cut the banana and strawberries with a butter knife.
A grown-up peels and cuts the kiwi.
Put 2 spoons of yogurt in the bottom of each glass.
Add one fruit colour at a time: red, orange, yellow, green, blue!
Add a little more yogurt on top, then sprinkle the granola.
Drizzle a little honey and eat it with a spoon!
rainbow-parfait.tip: Use a clear glass so you can see your rainbow.

foul-face-sandwich.title: Funny-Face Foul Sandwich
foul-face-sandwich.intro: The Egyptian breakfast favourite, with a smiling face!
steps: A grown-up warms the foul in the microwave for 1 minute.
Mash the foul with a fork. Squish, squish!
Squeeze the lemon over the foul. Watch out for seeds!
Add the oil, cumin and salt, then stir.
Open the bread pocket carefully and spoon the foul inside.
Give it a face: cucumber eyes and a tomato smile!
foul-face-sandwich.tip: Add a boiled egg for a funny nose.

smiley-toast.title: Smiley-Face Toast
smiley-toast.intro: Crunchy toast with a fruit smile!
steps: A grown-up toasts the bread in the toaster.
Wait a minute for it to cool a little.
Spread the labneh on the toast with a butter knife.
Slice the banana and strawberries.
Make a face: blueberry eyes, a strawberry smile and banana hair!
Add a thin line of honey, then eat!
smiley-toast.tip: Try a cat face, a sun or a car!

overnight-oats.title: Overnight Oats in a Jar
overnight-oats.intro: Make it before bed, and breakfast is ready in the morning!
ingredients: A handful of berries or any fruit you like
steps: Put the oats in the jar.
Add the milk, yogurt and honey.
Close the lid tight, then shake the jar hard!
Put it in the fridge overnight.
In the morning, slice the banana with a butter knife.
Top the oats with fruit and eat with a spoon!
overnight-oats.tip: Add a spoon of cocoa for chocolate oats.

labneh-balls.title: Labneh Balls with Za'atar
labneh-balls.intro: Little balls of labneh rolled in green za'atar.
steps: Chill the labneh for 30 minutes so it is easy to shape.
Rub a little olive oil on your hands.
Take a teaspoon of labneh and roll it into a ball between your hands.
Roll each ball in the za'atar.
Put them on a plate with a little olive oil.
Eat them with bread!
labneh-balls.tip: Roll some in sesame seeds or paprika for different colours.

mini-manakish.title: Mini Za'atar Manakish
mini-manakish.intro: Little breads with za'atar and olive oil that make the whole house smell good!
steps: Put the za'atar and olive oil in the bowl.
Stir until it becomes a green paste.
Put the breads on the baking tray.
Spread the za'atar mix on each bread with the back of a spoon.
Crumble a little cheese on some if you like.
A grown-up bakes them at 200°C (400°F) for 8 minutes.
Wait 2 minutes, then tear and enjoy.
mini-manakish.tip: Add tomato and cucumber on top after baking.

egg-muffins.title: Egg Muffin Cups
egg-muffins.intro: Eggs, veggies and cheese in little cups, like cupcakes!
ingredients: Half a bell pepper, diced by a grown-up
A little oil for the tin
steps: Rub a little oil inside the muffin tin.
Crack the eggs into the bowl, one at a time.
Add the milk and salt.
Whisk until it is all yellow.
Cut the cherry tomatoes in half with a butter knife.
Share the pepper, tomatoes and cheese between the cups.
Pour the egg over them until each cup is about half full.
A grown-up bakes them at 180°C (350°F) for 18 minutes.
Wait 5 minutes, then lift them out with a spoon.
egg-muffins.tip: Add corn, peas or any vegetable you like.

ants-on-a-log.title: Ants on a Log
ants-on-a-log.intro: Crunchy celery logs with a line of yummy "ants" on top.
ingredients: 4 tablespoons peanut butter (or tahini or cream cheese)
steps: Wash the celery under running water and dry it.
A grown-up cuts each stick into 3 short logs.
Fill each log with peanut butter using a butter knife.
Put the raisin "ants" in a line on top of each log.
Count your ants, then crunch!
ants-on-a-log.tip: Try dried cranberries to make red "ladybugs".

rainbow-fruit-kebabs.title: Rainbow Fruit Kebabs
rainbow-fruit-kebabs.intro: Thread fruit onto sticks in every colour of the rainbow.
steps: Wash all the fruit and dry it.
A grown-up peels the kiwi and cuts the big fruit into chunks.
Peel the mandarins and pull them into pieces.
Push the fruit onto a stick in rainbow order: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple.
Hold the stick carefully: the tip is pointy!
rainbow-fruit-kebabs.tip: Dip them in yogurt mixed with a little honey.

date-energy-balls.title: Date & Oat Energy Balls
date-energy-balls.intro: Sweet date balls with no oven: you roll them with your hands!
steps: A grown-up covers the dates with warm water. Wait 10 minutes.
Pour off the water, then mash the dates with a fork into a paste.
Add the oats, tahini and cocoa.
Stir with a spoon, then squish it all together with clean hands.
Roll little balls, as big as a large marble.
Roll each ball in coconut, like snow!
Put them in the fridge for 20 minutes, then enjoy!
date-energy-balls.tip: Roll some in cocoa and some in coconut for a two-colour plate.

cucumber-caterpillar.title: Cucumber Caterpillar
cucumber-caterpillar.intro: A cute green caterpillar made of cucumber and tomato.
steps: Wash and dry the cucumber.
A grown-up slices the cucumber into circles.
Line up the circles in a wiggly line, like a caterpillar.
Put a dot of cream cheese on each circle.
Add a tomato head, raisin eyes and carrot feelers!
Start at the tail. Crunch, crunch!
cucumber-caterpillar.tip: Make a stripy one with cucumber and carrot slices.

apple-donuts.title: Apple "Donuts"
apple-donuts.intro: Apple rings that look like donuts, but they are fruit!
ingredients: 4 tablespoons thick yogurt or cream cheese
steps: Wash the apple.
A grown-up takes out the core and cuts the apple into thick rings.
Mix the yogurt with the honey.
Spread the yogurt on each apple ring.
Decorate with sprinkles and granola.
Eat them before the yogurt slides off!
apple-donuts.tip: Try peanut butter and raisins instead of yogurt.

hummus-veggie-face.title: Hummus Veggie Face
hummus-veggie-face.intro: A plate of hummus that smiles back, with veggie eyes and hair!
steps: Wash all the vegetables.
A grown-up cuts the carrots into sticks, the cucumber into circles and the pepper into strips.
Spread the hummus into a big circle on the plate.
Make cucumber eyes, a tomato nose and a pepper smile.
Add carrot sticks around the face for hair!
Dip the veggies and bread in the hummus.
hummus-veggie-face.tip: Make a lion with lots of carrot hair.

banana-snowmen.title: Banana Snowmen
banana-snowmen.intro: A little snowman on a stick that you can eat!
ingredients: A tiny piece of carrot for the nose
steps: Peel the bananas.
Cut the bananas into thick circles with a butter knife.
Push 3 banana circles onto a stick: that is your snowman!
A grown-up cuts the top off a strawberry to make a hat.
Put the hat on top, then add chocolate-chip eyes and buttons and a carrot nose.
Eat it before it turns brown!
banana-snowmen.tip: Freeze it for 30 minutes for a really cold snowman.

cracker-towers.title: Cheese & Cracker Towers
cracker-towers.intro: Build the tallest tower you can... then eat it!
steps: Cut the cheese into shapes with a cutter, or break it into squares.
Tear the lettuce into small pieces with your hands.
Cut the tomatoes in half with a butter knife.
Build: cracker, cheese, lettuce, cucumber, then another cracker!
Put half a tomato on the very top.
Who built the tallest tower? Now eat it!
cracker-towers.tip: Try olives or labneh for a new floor.

tortilla-pinwheels.title: Tortilla Pinwheels
tortilla-pinwheels.intro: Roll up a tortilla and slice it to see colourful spirals!
steps: Spread cream cheese all over the tortilla.
Sprinkle on the grated carrot and cheese.
Cover it with lettuce leaves.
Roll the tortilla up tight, like a rug.
A grown-up cuts it into slices.
Lay them on the plate to see the spirals!
tortilla-pinwheels.tip: Add spinach or cucumber for more colours.

frozen-yogurt-bark.title: Frozen Yogurt Bark
frozen-yogurt-bark.intro: Frozen yogurt and fruit that you break into pieces like chocolate.
steps: Mix the yogurt and honey.
Cover the tray with baking paper.
Spread the yogurt on the paper with the back of a spoon.
Cut the strawberries into small pieces.
Sprinkle the fruit and granola over the yogurt.
Freeze for 3 hours.
Break it into pieces with your hands and eat it quickly!
frozen-yogurt-bark.tip: Add coconut or chocolate chips too.

fruit-ice-pops.title: Fruit Ice Pops
fruit-ice-pops.intro: Colourful pops made of juice and fruit pieces, for hot days.
steps: Cut the strawberries into small pieces with a butter knife.
A grown-up peels and cuts the kiwi.
Drop the fruit pieces into the moulds.
Pour in the juice almost to the top.
Push in the sticks or the mould lid.
Freeze for at least 4 hours.
Hold the mould under warm water for a few seconds so the pops slide out.
fruit-ice-pops.tip: Make two layers: orange juice, then strawberry juice.

pita-pizza-faces.title: Pita Pizza Faces
pita-pizza-faces.intro: Little pizzas on flatbread, each with a funny face you make yourself!
ingredients: 1 small green pepper, cut into strips by a grown-up
steps: Put the breads on the baking tray.
Spread 2 spoons of sauce on each bread with the back of a spoon.
Sprinkle cheese all over the bread.
Make a face: olive eyes, a tomato nose and a pepper smile.
A grown-up bakes them at 200°C (400°F) for about 10 minutes, until the cheese melts.
Wait 3 minutes, because hot cheese burns! Then eat.
pita-pizza-faces.tip: Make silly hair with extra pepper strips.

homemade-hummus.title: Homemade Hummus
homemade-hummus.intro: Smooth, creamy hummus you make yourself in minutes.
steps: Rinse the chickpeas in the sieve under the tap.
Squeeze the lemon on the lemon squeezer.
Put the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice and salt in the blender.
Add the garlic and cold water.
A grown-up blends it until very smooth.
Spread it on a plate and make a swirl with the spoon.
Finish with olive oil and paprika.
homemade-hummus.tip: Add cooked beetroot for pink hummus!

fattoush.title: Fattoush Salad
fattoush.intro: A crunchy salad with toasted bread, and you tear the lettuce yourself!
steps: Tear the bread into small pieces with your hands.
A grown-up toasts them in the oven for 7 minutes until crunchy.
Wash all the vegetables.
Tear the lettuce and mint into the bowl.
A grown-up cuts the cucumber and radishes.
Cut the cherry tomatoes in half with a butter knife.
Squeeze in the lemon, add the oil and salt, then toss.
Add the crunchy bread last, so it stays crunchy!
fattoush.tip: Sprinkle sumac on top if you have it.

pasta-salad.title: Colourful Pasta Salad
pasta-salad.intro: Fun pasta shapes with vegetables in every colour.
steps: A grown-up boils the pasta in salty water for about 10 minutes.
The grown-up drains it and rinses it with cold water.
A grown-up cuts the pepper and cucumber into cubes.
Cut the cherry tomatoes in half with a butter knife.
Put the pasta, corn, cheese and vegetables in the bowl.
Squeeze in the lemon and add the oil and salt.
Stir gently until all the colours are mixed.
pasta-salad.tip: Add tuna or olives for a bigger salad.

koshari-bowl.title: Build-Your-Own Koshari Bowl
koshari-bowl.intro: Egyptian koshari, and you build your bowl layer by layer!
steps: A grown-up cooks the rice, lentils and pasta, or warms them up if they are ready-made.
The grown-up warms the tomato sauce with the cumin.
Put rice and lentils in the bottom of your bowl.
Add a layer of pasta.
Sprinkle the chickpeas on top.
Spoon on the warm sauce with a ladle, carefully!
Top it with crispy onions!
koshari-bowl.tip: Grown-ups who like it spicy add the garlic-vinegar sauce.

kofta-fingers.title: Oven Kofta Fingers
kofta-fingers.intro: Shape kofta fingers with your hands, and the oven does the rest.
ingredients: 1 small onion, grated by a grown-up
steps: Pull the parsley leaves into small bits.
Put the meat, onion and parsley in the bowl.
Add the breadcrumbs, cumin and salt.
Put on gloves and squish it all together.
Shape long fingers like sausages and put them on the tray.
Wash your hands well with soap after touching raw meat.
A grown-up bakes them at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes.
Eat them with bread and salad!

chicken-nuggets.title: Crunchy Oven Chicken Nuggets
chicken-nuggets.intro: Nuggets with a cornflake crunch, baked instead of fried.
steps: A grown-up cuts the chicken into bite-size pieces.
Put the cornflakes, paprika and salt in a bag and close it.
Squash the bag with your hands until it is all crumbs!
Crack the egg into the bowl and beat it with a fork.
Put on gloves and dip each piece in the egg.
Then roll it in the cornflakes and put it on the tray.
Wash your hands well with soap after touching raw chicken.
A grown-up bakes them at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes, until cooked all the way through.
chicken-nuggets.tip: Dip them in ketchup or garlic yogurt.

stuffed-pita-pockets.title: Stuffed Pita Pockets
stuffed-pita-pockets.intro: Bread pockets you fill with everything you like!
steps: A grown-up slices the cucumber and tomato.
They also cut each bread in half to make two pockets.
Tear the lettuce with your hands.
Open a pocket and spoon in the cheese.
Push the vegetables inside.
Add the olives last and press gently.
Hold it with both hands and eat!
stuffed-pita-pockets.tip: Try boiled egg or hummus instead of cheese.

cheese-quesadilla.title: Cheese Quesadilla Triangles
cheese-quesadilla.intro: Crispy tortilla with melty cheese that stretches with every bite!
steps: Sprinkle the cheese over half of the tortilla.
Add the corn and pepper.
Fold the tortilla in half like a book.
A grown-up cooks it in the pan for 2 minutes.
The grown-up flips it until the cheese melts.
A grown-up cuts it into triangles.
Wait 2 minutes: the cheese is very hot!
cheese-quesadilla.tip: Dip them in yogurt or tomato sauce.

magic-vegetable-soup.title: Magic Vegetable Soup
magic-vegetable-soup.intro: Put colourful vegetables in the pot and watch the magic happen!
steps: Wash all the vegetables well.
A grown-up peels the vegetables and cuts them into cubes.
Put the vegetables into the cold pot, before the stove is on.
Add the peas and tomatoes. Count the peas if you can!
Add the water and salt.
A grown-up cooks the soup for 25 minutes until the vegetables are soft.
Tear the parsley and sprinkle it over the soup.
Wait 5 minutes and blow before you eat!
magic-vegetable-soup.tip: Add vermicelli or small pasta for a heartier soup.

egg-salad-sandwiches.title: Egg Salad Sandwiches
egg-salad-sandwiches.intro: Peel and mash the eggs yourself for a yummy sandwich.
steps: A grown-up boils the eggs for 10 minutes.
The grown-up puts the eggs in cold water to cool.
Tap the egg on the table, then peel it. Fun!
Mash the eggs with a fork in the bowl.
Add the yogurt, salt and cumin, and stir.
Spread the egg salad on a slice of bread.
Add a lettuce leaf and put another slice on top.
Cut it into fun shapes with a cookie cutter!
egg-salad-sandwiches.tip: Add a little dill or spring onion.

sweet-potato-wedges.title: Sweet Potato Wedges
sweet-potato-wedges.intro: Crispy orange wedges from the oven, sweet and salty at once!
steps: Wash and scrub the sweet potatoes.
A grown-up cuts them into thick wedges.
Put them in the bowl with the oil.
Sprinkle on the paprika and salt.
Toss them until they are all coated.
Lay them on the tray so they do not touch.
A grown-up bakes them at 200°C (400°F) for 25 minutes.
Wait 3 minutes, then eat them with your fingers!
sweet-potato-wedges.tip: Dip them in yogurt with mint.

ghorayeba.title: Ghorayeba Butter Cookies
ghorayeba.intro: Snowy-white Eid cookies that melt in your mouth, with just three ingredients!
ingredients: ½ cup soft butter or ghee
steps: Mix the soft butter and powdered sugar until creamy and white.
Add the flour a little at a time.
Squeeze it with your hands into a soft dough.
Roll small balls, put them on the tray and press them down a little.
Press one pistachio on top of each cookie.
A grown-up bakes them at 160°C (320°F) for 15 minutes. They should stay white!
Let them cool completely: warm ghorayeba breaks easily.
ghorayeba.tip: Shape the dough into hearts or moons instead of balls.

chocolate-banana-pops.title: Chocolate Banana Pops
chocolate-banana-pops.intro: Bananas on a stick, dipped in chocolate, covered in sprinkles, then frozen!
steps: Peel the bananas.
Cut each banana in half with a butter knife.
Push a stick into the cut end of each half.
A grown-up melts the chocolate in the microwave, 30 seconds at a time.
Dip each banana into the chocolate and turn it.
Quick! Add sprinkles before the chocolate sets.
Put them on a tray in the freezer for 2 hours.
chocolate-banana-pops.tip: Try crushed biscuits instead of sprinkles.

eid-kahk.title: Eid Kahk Cookies
eid-kahk.intro: Shape and stamp Eid kahk like Teta did, filled with dates!
ingredients: Powdered sugar to dust on top
steps: Put the flour, sugar and baking powder in the bowl.
Add the soft butter and milk.
Knead with your hands into a smooth dough that does not stick.
Roll the date paste into tiny balls.
Flatten a ball of dough, put a date ball in the middle and close it up.
Stamp the top with a kahk stamp, or draw lines with a fork.
A grown-up bakes them at 180°C (350°F) for 15 minutes.
Once cool, dust them with powdered sugar like snow!
eid-kahk.tip: Fill some with Turkish delight or chocolate.

one-bowl-basbousa.title: One-Bowl Basbousa
one-bowl-basbousa.intro: Golden basbousa soaked in syrup, all mixed in one bowl!
ingredients: 1 cup cold sugar syrup, made ahead by a grown-up
steps: A grown-up melts the butter in the microwave.
Put the semolina, sugar, coconut and baking powder in the bowl.
Add the yogurt and melted butter.
Stir with the spoon until everything is mixed.
Spread the mix in a greased tray and smooth the top.
Mark squares or diamonds with a butter knife.
Press an almond into the middle of each piece.
A grown-up bakes it at 180°C (350°F) for 30 minutes, until golden.
The grown-up pours the cold syrup over the hot basbousa. Tssss!
one-bowl-basbousa.tip: Leave it for an hour to soak up the syrup before eating.

mahalabiya-cups.title: Decorated Mahalabiya Cups
mahalabiya-cups.intro: Smooth white milk pudding that you decorate with colours!
steps: Pour 1 cup of the cold milk into the pot.
Add the cornstarch and sugar.
Whisk well until the cornstarch disappears.
Add the rest of the milk.
A grown-up cooks it on low heat, stirring until thick.
The grown-up stirs in the vanilla and pours it into cups.
Chill for 2 hours until set.
Decorate with pistachios, strawberries and sprinkles however you like!
mahalabiya-cups.tip: Add a spoon of cocoa for chocolate mahalabiya.

om-ali-croissants.title: Om Ali with Croissants
om-ali-croissants.intro: A warm Egyptian pudding with milk and nuts, made the easy way with croissants.
steps: Tear the croissants into big pieces with your hands.
Spread them out in the oven dish.
Sprinkle the raisins, coconut and nuts between the pieces.
A grown-up heats the milk with the sugar until it boils.
The grown-up pours the hot milk over the croissants.
Add little spoonfuls of cream on top if you like.
A grown-up bakes it at 200°C (400°F) for 15 minutes, until golden on top.
Wait 5 minutes: it is very hot!
om-ali-croissants.tip: Try banana pieces instead of raisins.

chocolate-biscuit-salami.title: Chocolate Biscuit "Salami"
chocolate-biscuit-salami.intro: A no-bake treat that looks like salami, but it is chocolate and biscuits!
steps: Put the biscuits in a bag and close it.
Break the biscuits into small pieces with your hands, but not too fine.
A grown-up melts the chocolate, butter and milk in the microwave.
Tip the biscuits into the melted chocolate.
Stir until all the biscuits are covered.
Put the mix on cling film and roll it into a sausage.
Chill for 2 hours until firm.
Dust it with powdered sugar, then a grown-up slices it.
chocolate-biscuit-salami.tip: Add mini marshmallows or raisins to the mix.

cookie-cutter-cookies.title: Cookie-Cutter Butter Cookies
cookie-cutter-cookies.intro: Roll out the dough and pick your shapes: stars, hearts and animals!
steps: Mix the butter and sugar until creamy.
Add the egg and vanilla and stir.
Add the flour a little at a time.
Knead with your hands into a smooth ball.
Roll out the dough until it is as thick as your little finger.
Press out stars, hearts and animals with the cutters!
Put them on the tray and add sprinkles.
A grown-up bakes them at 180°C (350°F) for 10 minutes.
Let them cool for 15 minutes before eating.
cookie-cutter-cookies.tip: Squash the leftover dough together and roll it out again.

mug-cake.title: Chocolate Mug Cake
mug-cake.intro: A whole cake in a mug, ready in a minute!
steps: Put the flour, sugar, cocoa and baking powder in the mug.
Stir with the fork.
Add the milk and oil.
Stir well until all the white bits are gone.
Sprinkle the chocolate chips on top.
A grown-up microwaves it for about 1 minute.
Wait 3 minutes: the mug is very hot!
mug-cake.tip: Top it with a spoon of yogurt or ice cream.

cornflake-nests.title: Cornflake Chocolate Nests
cornflake-nests.intro: Crunchy chocolate nests with little colourful eggs inside!
steps: A grown-up melts the chocolate in the microwave.
Add the cornflakes to the chocolate.
Stir gently until they are all covered.
Put a spoonful into each paper case.
Press the middle with the back of the spoon to make a nest.
Put little eggs in each nest!
Chill for 30 minutes.
cornflake-nests.tip: Use white chocolate for snowy nests.

banana-muffins.title: Banana Muffins
banana-muffins.intro: The best way to use brown bananas: soft, sweet muffins!
steps: Peel the bananas.
Mash the bananas with a fork until they are mushy.
Crack the egg over the bananas.
Add the sugar, oil and milk, and stir.
Add the flour and baking powder.
Stir gently just until the flour disappears. Do not over-mix!
Put paper cases in the tin and fill each one two-thirds full.
A grown-up bakes them at 180°C (350°F) for 20 minutes.
Let them cool for 10 minutes.
banana-muffins.tip: Add chocolate chips or raisins to the mix.

cream-qatayef.title: Cream-Filled Qatayef
cream-qatayef.intro: Ramadan qatayef filled with cream, with no frying or oven!
steps: Fold a qatayef in half and pinch just the bottom edge, so it stays open like a cone.
Fill the opening with cream using a teaspoon.
Dip the cream end into the green pistachios.
Line them up on the plate.
Drizzle a little honey or syrup on top.
Ramadan Kareem! Eat them cold.
cream-qatayef.tip: Dip some in coconut instead of pistachios.

date-maamoul.title: Date Maamoul
date-maamoul.intro: Date-filled Eid cookies that you shape with a mould or a fork.
steps: A grown-up melts the butter in the microwave.
Put the semolina, flour and sugar in the bowl.
Add the melted butter and milk.
Knead with your hands into a soft dough.
Roll the date paste into small balls.
Wrap each date ball in a piece of dough.
Press it into the maamoul mould and tap it out, or draw lines with a fork.
A grown-up bakes them at 180°C (350°F) for 20 minutes.
Once cool, dust them with powdered sugar.
date-maamoul.tip: Fill some with walnuts or pistachios if no one has a nut allergy.

chocolate-strawberries.title: Chocolate-Dipped Strawberries
chocolate-strawberries.intro: Red strawberries dipped in chocolate. Easy and pretty!
steps: Wash the strawberries and dry them really well.
A grown-up melts the chocolate in the microwave.
Hold a strawberry by its leaves and dip it in the chocolate.
Add sprinkles or coconut.
Put them on baking paper.
Chill for 20 minutes until the chocolate sets.
chocolate-strawberries.tip: Dip half of them in white chocolate.

rice-pudding.title: Rice Pudding
rice-pudding.intro: Creamy rice pudding with cinnamon, just like Teta made!
steps: Rinse the rice in the sieve until the water runs clear.
Put the rice and water in the pot.
A grown-up cooks the rice in the water for 10 minutes.
The grown-up adds the milk and sugar and cooks it on low heat for 25 minutes, stirring.
The grown-up stirs in the vanilla and pours it into bowls.
Let it cool, then put it in the fridge.
Decorate with cinnamon and raisins.
rice-pudding.tip: Draw a smiley face with the cinnamon!

strawberry-banana-smoothie.title: Strawberry-Banana Smoothie
strawberry-banana-smoothie.intro: A cold, pink, yummy drink you make in minutes.
steps: Wash the strawberries and pull off the green leaves.
Peel the banana and break it into pieces with your hands.
Put the fruit and yogurt into the blender.
Add the milk, honey and ice. Put the lid on tight!
A grown-up blends it until smooth and pink.
Pour it into glasses and say cheers!
strawberry-banana-smoothie.tip: Freeze any leftovers in ice-pop moulds.

mint-lemonade.title: Mint Lemonade
mint-lemonade.intro: Cold, fresh lemonade that you squeeze yourself!
steps: Wash the lemons and mint.
A grown-up cuts the lemons in half.
Squeeze each half on the lemon squeezer. Twist, twist!
Pour the juice into the jug and add the sugar.
Add the cold water and stir until the sugar dissolves.
Tear the mint and add it. Smell that!
Put ice in the glasses and pour in the lemonade.
mint-lemonade.tip: Add strawberry slices for pink lemonade.

hot-sahlab.title: Hot Sahlab
hot-sahlab.intro: A creamy, warm winter drink topped with nuts and cinnamon.
steps: Pour the cold milk into the pot.
Add the cornstarch and sugar.
Whisk until the cornstarch is gone.
A grown-up cooks it on low heat with the vanilla, stirring until thick.
The grown-up pours it into mugs.
Top it with coconut, nuts and cinnamon.
Wait a little and blow before you drink!
hot-sahlab.tip: Add raisins or banana slices on top.

iced-karkade.title: Iced Hibiscus (Karkade)
iced-karkade.intro: A ruby-red Egyptian drink, cold and refreshing!
steps: Put the hibiscus in the jug. Look how red it is!
A grown-up pours hot water over it.
Wait 15 minutes until it turns dark red.
The grown-up strains it through the sieve.
Add the sugar and stir until it dissolves.
Chill it in the fridge until very cold.
Pour it over ice, with a squeeze of lemon if you like.
iced-karkade.tip: Freeze it in ice-pop moulds for red ice pops.
